# Sandy Tayts

> Portfolio of Sandy Tayts, UX and service designer and consultant in San Francisco. Ten years of turning messy processes into systems people can use: case studies in service design, UX and UI, plus experimental and illustration work.

Every page below also exists as Markdown: replace `.html` with `.md`, or `/` with `/index.md`. Requests sent with `Accept: text/markdown` get the Markdown copy automatically.

## Case studies

- [Rancourt & Co.](https://sandy.tayts.com/rancourt.md): a Shopify store the brand's own team can run (2026). Research, data model, theme design.
- [Sales modernisation at BP](https://sandy.tayts.com/bigoil.md): energy sales moved into Salesforce and DocuSign (2023). UX and service design.
- [EY Digital Hub](https://sandy.tayts.com/dh.md): IT support rebuilt as an omnichannel service (2020). Service and integration design.
- [Lazy](https://sandy.tayts.com/lazy.md): a no-code website builder for independent vacation-rental hosts (2026). Founder, design and build.
- [Looped In](https://sandy.tayts.com/looped-in.md): a college incentives app (2015). UX and UI, design management.

## Experimental projects

- [Sarabesh](https://sandy.tayts.com/sarabesh/index.md): an explorable steampunk city, a game proof of concept.
- [Dwellers](https://sandy.tayts.com/dwellers/index.md): an augmented-reality scavenger hunt.
- [Noah Fixes the Rainbow](https://sandy.tayts.com/noah.md): an illustrated children's picture book.
- [No Grounds for Panic](https://sandy.tayts.com/panic.md): urban fantasy short stories, co-written and illustrated.
- [Early AI work](https://sandy.tayts.com/early-ai/index.md): illustration projects from 2022–2023.
- [Loomik](https://sandy.tayts.com/loomik/index.md): an AI-driven sales platform, UX and UI.
